generation.role: one new ordinary terminal generation shared only by ZERO/PLUS_E2/MINUS_E2; this is not recovery of the earlier tensor
generation.prompt: locked camera, a single matte white cube moving slowly across a dark plain table, stable lighting, no people, no cuts
generation.negative_prompt: text, watermark, logo, camera motion, cuts, multiple objects, flicker

c2a.near_singular_rule: reject if lambda_min <= 1e-8 * max(lambda_max, 1); no regularization or pseudoinverse
c2a.cache_reset: before and after each decode and encode

records_required: all three arm rows including failures
shared terminal and actual post-FP32-write block snapshots
pre-codec and post-MP4 q for each readable arm
O2/M2 vectors and norms for both layers
